name: The Deepest Drowned (Azir)
creator: sauronkaiser
description:
Base champion: Azir

Skin: Default

Author: Sauronkaiser

Description: The first of the undead heroes

Features:

-New model and textures.

-New full set of animations.

-New sounds.

-New particles

-New Splashart loading screen.

-New Ability icons and HUD.

-3 different soldier skins randomized

-A lot of different soldier skins in the ultimate

-Doplhin mount in the E.

-Special autoattack transitions when attacking and moving.

-A ton of friends from the sea.

-A ton of cameos in the ultimate.

-A chicken and lava.

-Scrapped content from a game made of cubes.

-No balls pressing CRL+5.

Meet the Undead heroes!

-The Coldest Stray (Senna):

Not uploaded yet

-Bryan the Hero (Kayle):

Not uploaded yet

Lore:

Long time ago, three mighty heroes managed to defeat the Wither Storm and save the overworld. Not much is known about them in the current days, but legends say one of them was a powerful summoner from beneath the seas...

Sources and references:

-The music used for the dance emote is Free The Angels, by The Lightbringer of Sweden.

-The metal scream in the taunt emote also comes from that song.

-All animations made by me.

-Particle effects mostly made by me.

-The joke emote references Lava Chicken from the Minecraft Movie.

-The taunt emote references the copper golem, scrapped content from Minecraft (tho afterwards it was added to the game)

-The laugh emote references the spanish youtuber Baitybait.

-The respawn emote features a Happy Ghast from minecraft.

-The ultimate features a lot of cameos from youtubers, such as Alexelcapo, Tonacho, Chincheto, etc.

-The ultimate also features a lot of my previous Minecraft-themed mods.

-Most of 3D models made by me except those listed below.
